entities.summary: Ernest Blerot was a Belgian architect who was born in Ixelles (Brussels) on February 21, 1870, and died in Ixelles on January 10, 1957. He was one of the most prolific Art Nouveau style Brussels architects of his time, and also worked as a property developer. Most of his work was produced from 1897 to 1909 and in particular between 1898 and 1904, the period during which he achieved around fifty houses.
